name: knowfirm-mcp
description: Read-only U.S. business lookup, search, screening, informational CFPB complaint-risk summary, and segment preview (Discover). Bring your own KnowFirm key; 1 credit per call (screening 2).

tools.name: business_lookup
tools.description: Read-only: resolve a U.S. business by name and return KYB/firmographic public-record data (1 credit). Informational, not an FCRA/compliance decision.

tools.name: business_search
tools.description: Read-only: search U.S. businesses by name/query and return candidate matches (1 credit). Informational, not an FCRA/compliance decision.

tools.name: business_screening
tools.description: Read-only: screen a name against the U.S. Consolidated Screening List and return scored matches (2 credits). Informational, not a sanctions clearance or FCRA/compliance decision.

tools.name: complaint_risk
tools.description: Read-only: informational CFPB complaint-risk summary for a U.S. business (1 credit). Not a consumer report or FCRA/compliance decision.

tools.name: business_segments
tools.description: Read-only: preview a segment of U.S. businesses from a public-record source, filtered by state/size/industry/filing recency — exact count plus a 25-row sample (1 credit). Informational, not an FCRA/compliance decision.

tools.name: lookalike_businesses
tools.description: Read-only: find up to 25 U.S. businesses similar to a seed business by industry, HQ state and size (1 credit). Informational, not an FCRA/compliance decision.
